# Reclaimed robot

Quaternius, **Animated Robot — October 2018**, CC0 1.0 Universal.
Source: `~/code/game-assets/quaternius/All in One - Quaternius[Patreon].zip`.
Archive model: `Characters and Animals/Animated Robot - Oct 2018/OBJ/Robot.obj`;
companion material and texture come from that same pack. The pack's original
`License.txt` is retained here as `LICENSE.txt`.

Greywrought's ruined guardians reuse the separate authored head, torso and limb
meshes with static broken poses, weathered materials, and buried fragments.
